scope: Read-only audit of exact-head hosted/native/C evidence. Audit itself changes no source or branches; PR metadata may be updated with completed evidence; Root independently reviewed and authorized guarded exact-head merge; proof included. No source or branch changes. Compare public and component measurements separately within the same job. Native and C job CPUs may differ; no summing cross-run gains.

native.plane_timing_backend: AVX512 executed on eligible changed fixtures
native.profile_limit: Short independent profiles establish sampled liveness, not isolated throughput or additive cumulative gains.

timing_contract.govpx: sum of EncodeInto call durations; input construction, warmup and allocation sampling excluded
timing_contract.libvpx: vpxenc cumulative vpx_codec_encode timer; subprocess/file wall timing reported separately
timing_contract.libvpx_latency: legacy helper latency fields repeat the mean, not measured latency quantiles; not used here
timing_contract.order: three govpx-first and three reference-first runs per case
timing_contract.quality: separate post-timing decode/PSNR/SSIM pass, same inputs and flags
timing_contract.scope: synthetic same-input/controls comparison; differing output/quality/drop work is reported, not assumed equivalent

limits: Root independently reviewed and authorized guarded exact-head merge; proof included.
AVX512 native acceptance requires CPU feature bundle and ordinary/race TestSSEPlane16AVX512 PASS with AVX512=true, no skip.
Kernel gains do not imply whole-codec gains or blanket assembly parity.
Compare main/old/current only within the same CPU/job; C job may use a separate CPU.
All median regressions/all-six-slower controls and every allocation sample retained without pruning.
Fixed VP8 matching measured PSNR/SSIM/payload/counts does not prove bitstream identity; adaptive/VP9 unequal work retained.
